_comment: Published reference points for the PGDA 5 m sites (cross-check of our 'dem-summit' catalog points; pipeline/jobs/validate_reference.py). Different kinds of points: De Rosa et al. 2012 = centres of regions of interest; Mazarico/Glaeser/Boazman = illumination maxima or site points; Pena-Asensio = chosen landing points. Barker et al. 2021 (Sec. 2) states Site 1/4/7/11 = CR1/SR1/SV1/GR1 of De Rosa et al.; Site20/Site23 matches are by name only. Longitudes east-positive.

refs.label: Mazarico et al. 2011 Site 1 point (as reproduced by Glaeser 2014, Table 7)
refs.pubNote: 89.01 % average illumination at the surface, 240 m/px, full precession cycle
refs.note: printed to 0.01 deg (about +-150 m in latitude) on a ridge crest a few hundred metres wide, so the rounded point can fall on the flank; the 4-decimal point of Glaeser 2014 (23 m from our summit) agrees within ~2 percentage points
